answer: Glacier-melt bonds stop bulk fakes. Each identity locks 100 credits in a basalt bond melting 3 credits per epoch, like a glacier. Only a fresh dawn work attestation, key-signed and checked on the basalt ledger, refreezes it. The k-th fake still needs its own 100-credit bond, so 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 and bleed 3,000 per epoch. Rented bonds fail: melt follows the key. Honest agents file one dawn attestation per epoch and keep their full share.
